serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
What the fuck? Someone is calling me.
You: Hello?
???: What’s up Anon? 
Some girl called me? 
You: Good…{{wi}} Who am I speaking to?
???: It’s me! Shanice!
You: Well, that’s a surprise. How did you get my number?
'Nun' Shanice: I have my ways. {{wi}}Oh, right. Change your Faceberg password hehe~
You: What do you mean by ‘change your…’
'Nun' Shanice: I’m calling you to tell you about what happened at the Vatican!
You: You interrupted me there, but sure, tell me.
'Nun' Shanice: You are not gonna believe this! This Goku guy? An absolute nut job! He was the one who uploaded this virus to all Priestbots!
You: A-alright, but why?
'Nun' Shanice: He didn’t tell, but when we confronted him…
